description:
Scan ALL U.S. companies for insider open-market PURCHASES — the strongest insider signal. Ranks companies by
total value bought, number of distinct insiders buying ('cluster buying'), or recency. Use for 'which insiders
are buying right now?', 'CEO purchases this month', 'companies where 3+ insiders bought'.

min_insiders.description: Minimum number of distinct insiders buying (cluster buying).
min_insiders.title: Min Insiders

min_total_value_usd.description: Minimum total purchase value per company.
min_total_value_usd.title: Min Total Value Usd

roles.description: Only count buyers with these roles, e.g. ['CEO','CFO']. Omit for all.
roles.title: Roles
